fullPassage: Plants are photosynthetic organisms that can create their own nourishment by using solar energy and minerals from the soil. Why, then, do some species of plants trap and seemingly eat insects and tiny animals like frogs? It is because they usually grow in nutrient-deficient habitats —like bogs— in which the soil is too acidic to provide necessary elements. Due to the environmental factors, over many successive generations, these plants have evolved unique mechanisms, such as pitcher-like bodies filled with sticky secretions or closing leaves, that trap animals. They have also gained enzymes that enable them to break down the food they consume and convert it into energy. As the enzymes work, they liquefy the prey’s body, releasing many of the nutrients that are absent from the soil. By absorbing this slurry, the plants get the nutrition they need to thrive in their ecosystem.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
① enzyme: 생물의 세포가 만들어 내 먹이 분해 같은 반응을 빠르게 하는 물질 ←정답

② mineral: 광물 — 토양의 무기질이라 달라요

③ insect: 곤충 — 식물이 잡는 먹이라 무관해요

④ bog: 습지 — 서식지라 무관해요
det.tip: speeds up reactions ~ breakdown of food → 효소(enzyme).

questions.passage: As the enzymes work, they liquefy the prey’s body, __________ (release) many of the nutrients that are absent from the soil. By absorbing this slurry, the plants get the nutrition they need to thrive in their ecosystem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: release → releasing: 앞 절 전체를 결과로 잇는 분사구문이라 현재분사(-ing)로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'As the enzymes work, they liquefy the prey's body, __________ many of the nutrients'에서 빈칸은 앞 내용을 '그래서 ~을 방출하며'로 잇는 분사구문 자리예요. and they release → releasing으로 바꿔 한 문장으로 이어요.

→ 따라서 release를 releasing으로 써요.
det.tip: 분사구문: and they release → releasing.

questions.passage: Due to the environmental factors, over many successive generations, these plants have evolved unique mechanisms, such as pitcher-like bodies __________ (fill) with sticky secretions or closing leaves, that trap animals. They have also gained enzymes that enable them to break down the food they consume and convert it into energy.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: fill → filled: 'bodies __________ with ~'는 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사(수동)라 filled로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'pitcher-like bodies __________ with sticky secretions'에서 빈칸은 bodies(몸체)를 뒤에서 꾸미는 분사 자리예요. 몸체가 분비물로 '채워진' 수동의 의미이니 fill을 과거분사 filled로 바꿔요. (bodies that are filled with ~)

→ 따라서 fill을 filled로 써요.
det.tip: bodies filled with ~ = ~로 채워진 몸체 (과거분사, 수동).

questions.passage: Plants are photosynthetic organisms that can create their own nourishment by using solar energy and minerals from the soil. Why, then, do some species of plants trap and seemingly eat insects and tiny animals like frogs? It is because they usually grow in nutrient-deficient habitats —like bogs— in which the soil is too acidic to provide necessary elements. Due to the environmental factors, over many successive __________, these plants have evolved unique mechanisms, such as pitcher-like bodies filled with sticky secretions or closing leaves, that trap animals. They have also gained enzymes that enable them to break down the food they consume and convert it into energy. As the enzymes work, they liquefy the prey’s body, releasing many of the nutrients that are absent from the soil. By absorbing this slurry, the plants get the nutrition they need to thrive in their ecosystem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'over many successive ______(여러 연속된 ______에 걸쳐)' 진화가 일어났다는 게 단서예요. 진화는 여러 세대에 걸쳐 일어나요.

① seasons: 계절은 진화가 일어나기엔 너무 짧아요

② colors: 색깔은 기간과 무관해요

③ minutes: 분은 진화 시간과 안 맞아요

④ generations: 여러 '세대'에 걸쳐 진화했어요 ←정답
det.tip: over many successive ______ ~ have evolved → 세대(generations).

questions.passage: Plants are photosynthetic organisms that can create their own nourishment by using solar energy and minerals from the soil. Why, then, do some species of plants trap and seemingly eat insects and tiny animals like frogs? It is because they usually grow in nutrient-deficient habitats —like bogs— in which the soil is too acidic to provide necessary elements. Due to the environmental factors, over many successive generations, these plants have evolved unique mechanisms, such as pitcher-like bodies filled with sticky secretions or closing leaves, that trap animals. They have also gained enzymes that enable them to break down the food they consume and convert it into energy. As the enzymes work, they liquefy the prey’s body, releasing many of the __________ that are absent from the soil. By absorbing this slurry, the plants get the nutrition they need to thrive in their ecosystem.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤 'releasing many of the ______ that are absent from the soil(토양에 없는 많은 ______을 방출하며)'가 단서예요. 식물이 부족한 양분을 얻는 내용이에요.

① dangers: 위험은 식물이 얻으려는 대상이 아니에요

② shadows: 그림자는 문맥과 무관해요

③ nutrients: 토양에 없던 '양분'을 먹이에서 방출해 얻어요 ←정답

④ sounds: 소리는 문맥과 무관해요
det.tip: releasing many of the ______ that are absent from the soil → 양분(nutrients).
